text:
harry: Trying the new quickstart after accepting our SSO invite. First request returned 504 Gateway Timeout, then a retry returned 403 with no helpful UI message. App just shows 'Request failed (403)'.

harry: browser console shows two responses: first `504` with `upstream_timeout`, then `403` body {"error":"workspace_billing_required","message":"billing missing"}. Feels like a race between provisioning and gating.

onboard-bot: Hi @harry — new workspaces require a billing method to enable hosted endpoints. Add payment here: https://console.redwood.ai/workspaces/oz7/billing :credit_card:

jo: hmm that's interesting. Are you using the browser OAuth flow? sometimes the client retries and hits a transient 504 during provisioning window.

harry: yes browser OAuth (Okta). I accepted invite, clicked ToS, landed on the sample, hit "Run" immediately. We later attached billing but the quickstart didn't recover automatically.

jo: short-term workaround: start the server with a service API key locally so it bypasses workspace gating: `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=sk_test_... && npm run dev`. Also refresh the page after adding billing.

franz: two action items: (1) quickstart client should show an explicit message when backend returns `workspace_billing_required` (map to a banner with link + retry button), (2) infra should add a header like `x-redwood-why: billing_required` on 403s to make detection easier for non-JS clients.

franz: I'll open starter-repo PR to add the UI mapping and a simple polling retry when users click retry (poll for 30s).

infra-bot: created INF-778: "add x-redwood-why header for billing-required responses" assigned to @franz.

jo: also a small UX note: show a clearer message for the 504 case during provisioning, e.g. "Provisioning the workspace, try again in a minute" rather than a generic timeout. That will reduce support tickets.

harry: agreed. I lost track which error to report to support since two different codes appeared. Can we include the raw error code in our telemetry so support can triage faster?

franz: yes — will emit `onboard.missing_billing` telemetry when we hit that 403 and include last response code for the session.

harry: thanks — verified service key workaround and unblocked my testing. leaving thread open until PR + infra ticket are resolved.
